In MP, changes are applied by the server. Edit a value, then press Set.
Frequent sneezing and coughing, itching in various parts of the body. You feel pain from scratching.
Itching over most of your body. The pain increases significantly.
The allergy has spread throughout your body. Fatigue increases while endurance and health decrease.

You have gone too long without killing anyone, and your mood is affected even more.
You are at risk of developing permanent mood problems.

Caffeine in the body. You are in a good mood.

Flimsy/Frail remove 1/2 Strength levels; Flabby/Brittle Knees remove 1/2 Fitness levels.\nDTEM stores the exact XP removed and restores it when the penalty eases.\nStacks with vanilla weight penalties. Enabled by default.
Applies the configured starting XP tier when a skill trait is gained dynamically.\nRemoving the trait removes only the XP tracked by DTEM.\nFitness and Strength are excluded.

Controls how often Severe Cold adds Food Sickness.\nHigher values increase frequency and average accumulation; lower values reduce both.\nAt 1.0, uses a fixed 25-second real-time-equivalent window, independent of Day Length.
Enables the overdose counter, moodle and related DTEM effects.
Allows Melancholic and Nervous Wreck to develop dynamically through medication-related systems.
Scales Food Sickness increases added by DTEM.\nLower values reduce each increase; higher values increase it.\nSeparate from the Wound/Cold Sickness Rate Multipliers, which control frequency.

Controls how often infected wounds add Food Sickness.\nHigher values increase frequency and average accumulation; lower values reduce both.\nAt 1.0, uses a fixed 25-second real-time-equivalent window, independent of Day Length.

Eating disorder. Intense fear of gaining weight.

Your body condition is terrible. Optional sandbox rules can greatly reduce Strength.

Bleeding causes twice as much health loss.
